The sim has NO being-attacked channel (v1 boss deals no damage, no HP pool) and no trigger primitive for hits RECEIVED — hitCount counts the owner's own outgoing rounds, which is a different event entirely.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding the trigger as hitCount:20 (the unit's OWN attacks) or interval, granting a periodic self defPct buff — misreading 'attacked' (passive voice, hits received) as 'attacks' (hits dealt). Second-order misread: inventing a boss attack cadence to drive it.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Event log contains ZERO buffApply with stat 'defPct' value 39.18 across the whole fight (faithful = line lives verbatim in unmodeled, no block); nearest-wrong emits periodic defPct 39.18 self-applies keyed to mica's own shot count.
spec.inertness: Must move nothing: totals for all five units identical with the line absent. Self defPct is engine-inert in v1 anyway, but the block itself must not exist (no invented trigger).

spec.scope: Weapon-state modifier — taxonomy #6: ammo capacity IS damage (gates shots fired / reload frequency). Never a skip.

spec.triggerIdentity: The ■ header carries only a target clause, NO 'Activates when' — per convention that is an interval trigger at the datamined skill CD, first fire at t=CD (no force-cast wording). The CD itself is not in the prose (the base-stat 'cd 20s' is the Burst-I cooldown, not skill2's) — cadence is datamine-sourced, ⚑ if unverified.
spec.targetSet: alliesTopAtk count:2, byFinalAtk:true — prose literally says 'highest final ATK', which mandates live effectiveAtk ranking (the A3 rule); no '(except self)' clause, so self stays in the candidate pool (a Supporter rarely wins it, but the pool must not silently exclude her).
spec.nearestWrongModel: stat maxAmmoPct value 2 (percent instead of flat rounds — on a 6-ammo RL ally +2% rounds to zero extra rounds vs the true +2 flat), or durationShots:10 from the 'round(s)' token, or static-ATK ranking (byFinalAtk omitted) because plain-'highest ATK' kits default static.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply events with stat 'maxAmmoFlat' value 2 recur at the skill-CD interval, each with exactly 2 targetIdx recipients (the two highest-FINAL-ATK units) and expiresFrame ≈ applyFrame+600; nearest-wrong emits stat 'maxAmmoPct' (or a durationShots field) instead and is red on the stat/field filter. Carry's shot economy must shift vs a patched-out control (withPatchedOverride stripping the effect → fewer shots in windows covering reload boundaries).

Burst-cast damage is always FB-exempt by timing (lands before the FB window opens): no +50% major, no FB-entry auras, and no range bonus on riders.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying it to fullBurstEnter (fires on EVERY team FB even when liter, the other Burst-I in the fixture, won the B1 slot — over-credits in exactly the multi-B1 comp the harness builds), or leaving the +50% Full Burst major applied to the hit.

Test must first confirm mica actually casts B1 (see notes).

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF, not a self/ally stat: enemy DEF down raises the WHOLE TEAM's damage through the formula's DEF term for 5s after her cast (taxonomy #4 — never skip an enemy-targeted line as 'defensive').

spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding it as damageTakenPct 13.32 ('boss takes 13.32% more') — a DEF ▼ is NOT a damage-taken % (the damage delta depends on the formula's ATK−DEF relation, so the equivalence silently over- or under-credits); or applying it as an ally DEF ▲; or 10s duration.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On each mica burstCast: a buffApply with stat 'defPct', negative value 13.32-magnitude, casterIdx === null AND targetIdx === null, expiresFrame ≈ castFrame+300 — and NO buffApply of stat 'damageTakenPct' 13.32 anywhere. Team damage summed inside the 5s window exceeds the same window with the effect patched out; red if the debuff is stat-swapped, ally-targeted, or 10s. If the engine's DEF term turns out not to consume an enemy defPct debuff, that is a GAP the driver must declare, not a silent skip.

notes: Three expected shared-prior traps. (1) FIXTURE VALIDITY: mica is Burst I, but controlComp(carry) seats the carry in the B3 slot alongside liter (also Burst I) — in that fixture mica competes with liter for stage 1 and may cast rarely or never, making every burstCast assertion vacuous. Tests MUST either build a comp where mica is the sole B1 or first assert mica's burstCast events actually occur (and separately exercise a liter-casts rotation to pin the over-credit case against fullBurstEnter). (2) skill2's '▲ 2 round(s) for 10 sec' packs an amount-in-rounds next to a duration-in-seconds — the plausible misreads are maxAmmoPct:2 (flat-vs-percent) and durationShots:10; the faithful encoding is maxAmmoFlat value 2 + durationSec 10, and the stat-key filter on buffApply distinguishes them cleanly. (3) The burst DEF ▼ is an enemy debuff whose nearest-wrong is a damageTakenPct conversion; the two are NOT interchangeable and the assertion must pin stat identity, null caster/target indices, and the 5s (not 10s) expiry. Cadence caveat: skill2 has no activation clause, so its trigger is interval-at-datamined-CD with first fire at t=CD; the CD is outside the prose (the base-stat 20s is her burst CD) — the driver must source it from the datamine and ⚑ it if unverified. Skill1 is UNMODELED on two independent grounds (no being-attacked channel in the sim; self defPct inert) and must appear verbatim in the override's unmodeled field with no invented trigger.
